You're absolutely right—my apologies for that oversight. If the integration suite includes visual snapshot tests, then a CSS change is very likely the culprit. Visual snapshot tests compare rendered output against baseline images, so any CSS modifications would directly affect what those tests see.

The CI failure is probably legitimate: either your CSS changes altered the visual appearance in an unintended way, or the baselines need to be updated to reflect your intentional CSS modifications.

Check the CI logs for which specific visual snapshots failed and compare them against your CSS changes to determine if it's an expected visual change (in which case you'd update the baselines) or an unintended side effect you need to fix.
